title: Handover for the next visit
description: A short brief for whoever visits next: what happened since their last visit, what is due, and anything to check while there.
instructions: Write a handover the next visitor can read on their phone in one minute. Sections: 'Since you were last here' (max 4 items), 'Due during your visit' (routines and tasks due in the next 2 days), 'Check while you are there' (anything flagged watch). Cite note ids. Short sentences.
